comments.text: May Regulus-san's creepiness reach everyone!!

"Those base wretches who can't admit fault" -> the other Sin Archbishops.
Every single Sin Archbishop looks at the others and thinks, "Ugh, what a piece of trash." They do not get along.

By the way, about naked Emilia: Regulus was not the one who took her clothes off, so rest assured.
The ones who undressed Emilia were Regulus's wives. No. 184 was assigned to do it, so she was the one.

O-Opening!
So you were alive!!

On Emilia's side, we got to see just how outrageously overbearing Regulus-san is, but on the Subaru side of things, the group is fighting a Sin Archbishop over the City Hall.
Last time, they encountered Roy Alphard, who calls himself "Gluttony," and Subaru flew into a rage. So then, what happens next?

Against Roy, who moves like a beast, Julius calls Subaru a "little-girl user."
As the cases of Rem and Crusch make clear, stating your "name" can be fatal.
I like Crusch-san's "Please don't let go of me!" just now, so I had her cling on and kept it in, haha.
Standing so boldly against a Black Dragon. Even having lost her memories, Crusch-san still has all her sword talent and sword strength intact.
That evil sound coming from beyond the door -- last time, amid Capella's broadcast, there were all those screams and those squelching noises. What exactly were they indicating, desu.

At last, the Sin Archbishop of "Lust," Capella Emerada Lugunica, makes her grand full-body appearance.
Mm, she's infuriating.

Capella of "Lust" has the power of mutation and transformation.
She can freely transform both her own appearance and other people's. All those giant flies were humans who were in the City Hall. Capella's view is that if everything besides herself becomes ugly and horrifying, then no one will be able to love anyone but her. What an extreme take!

Capella has never seen Emilia in person, nor does she know that Subaru loves Emilia.
She just uses her sharp eye to read people's reactions and behavior, figure out their preferences, and take the form of whatever they like. A truly nasty talent.

As for the Black Dragon that Crusch-san hacked to pieces, the one that greeted Subaru and the others outside the City Hall was Capella (in dragon form), while inside the building she turned someone else into a Black Dragon and disguised herself as a child.
It was a nasty trick meant to make any intruders cut down a hostage, but the Black Dragon showed some grit there.
After seeing off the attack team headed for the City Hall, those who remained at the Muse Company await good news --.

It's a "Sorry and thank you" entry!!
In that moment, Kiritaka instinctively shielding Anastasia properly was genuinely great work. Liliana, you really shouldn't let go of this "songstress maniac"!

Ferris's forbidden move is magic that removes the sense of pain from severe injuries while forcibly holding the wounds at their current state.
There's no pain, but in exchange the wounds neither close nor worsen, so from a healer's point of view it's not exactly ideal.
The Zodda Bugs appeared in season 2 as well, but they're basically this world's equivalent of cockroaches, so even the usually fearless Felt screamed, "I'm sorry!!" So cute.
You Zodda Bug bastard!!

After the encounter with Lye Batenkaitos, it was the "White Dragon's Scale" who got Otto, who was in critical danger, to safety.
They're Kiritaka's private force and the Muse Company's trump card, and just like Anastasia's side, they're making the best possible moves by putting key fighting power exactly where it needs to be.

Of the watergates located around the four sides of the city, one of them was opened, and a muddy torrent came rushing in.
Garfiel with his hair plastered down is a rare sight, so it's kind of a special look, but this is not exactly the kind of moment where you have time to take screenshots!

E-Ending!!
So you were alive!!

The scenic Water Gate City has turned into a total disaster.
And this makes the third broadcast that's left us feeling awful.

An episode goes by so fast! It's over already!
An episode that can only be described as Capella going wild! At long last, every Sin Archbishop in the city has now shown their face!
"Wrath," "Greed," "Gluttony," and "Lust" -- these are the Sin Archbishops, Re:Zero's proud collection of "people who are viscerally unpleasant"!

With that, thank you again for this week!
It's late to say this now, but whoever came up with the titles "Attack Arc" and "Counterattack Arc" really thought it through. They're getting beaten so badly it can only be called the Attack Arc.
So with them getting wrecked this hard, what happens next week?! Where will the washed-away Subaru end up?! See you again next time!
